steps.content:
The two listings are identical on everything the pages show, so I can't pick one over the other on the facts.

| | Brackmoor Sound (a) | Ottervale Audio (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1 year limited | 1 year limited |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Box contents | Headphones, case, USB-C cable, 3.5 mm cable | Same |

The rating and review count match exactly. That may mean the reviews are shared at the product level and not specific to each seller. If so, the rating tells you nothing about which seller is better.

Before you buy, you could check a few things the pages don't show:
- **Seller reputation:** Look up each seller's own ratings, for example on a marketplace's seller profile or a third-party review site.
- **Authenticity:** Make sure the seller is an authorized reseller, since the warranty is described only as "limited". Check whether it's honored through the seller or the manufacturer.
- **Total cost:** Check at checkout for differences in tax, handling fees, or shipping estimates.
- **Return handling:** Check whether either seller has a stricter restocking or condition policy than the page says.

If none of those turn up a difference, either seller is fine. I'd go with whichever has the better independent seller reviews, or whichever offers the more convenient or secure checkout.
